title: JB & Sons
description: Sydney hospitality business operating across three venues — Narrabeen, Dee Why, and Manly. I co-own and run the technology side of the business, building and maintaining all internal software, ordering systems, and staff tooling.

title: JB Orders
description: End-to-end ordering platform for JB & Sons venues — customers order online, staff manage and fulfill orders in real time. Integrates Square POS, Uber Eats, and DoorDash with a Cloudflare Worker API and two Vue 3 SPAs.

title: JB Time

stack: React Native · Expo · Cloudflare Workers · Vue 3

title: Jumpy Jar
description: Early childhood education marketplace where creators sell digital learning resources to educators and parents. Features Stripe payments, Google OAuth, a creator dashboard, and an admin approval workflow — all on Cloudflare Workers.

title: FearAlert
description: SaaS email alert service that notifies subscribers when the Fear & Greed Index drops into fear territory. $2/week subscription via Stripe. Runs on Cloudflare Workers + D1 with hourly cron jobs and a custom email delivery pipeline.

title: Northstar Technology
